authorship: Original procedural geometry authored for SFACE. No generated images, image-to-3D input, scans, stock models, or external meshes.

design.role: A practical network field guide who can grow into both Explorer and Builder mission kits.
design.silhouette: Adult, upright and lightly tapered; narrow orange field jacket, compact seafoam signal pack, wrist scanner, and slim work boots.
design.proportions: Approximately 5.2 heads tall with a smaller head-to-body ratio, slim limbs, readable hands, and compact equipment.
design.surfaceLanguage: Smooth low-poly rounded anatomy, softened joint transitions, shaped clothing layers, a 23-bone body-and-face rig, a 25-sample planted walk cycle, restrained material response, and no decorative surface noise.
design.faceDirection: Soft tapered oval, shallow cheek volume, gently tapered horizontal eyes, subtle nose and mouth, straight brows, and layered side-swept black hair. East Asian-inspired original character design with no real-person likeness or caricature.
